records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During both the 2022 third quarter and first nine months, approximately 60% of KMT inland revenues were under term contracts and 40% were spot contract revenues.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consequently, KMT is directly affected by the volumes produced by the Company’s petroleum, petrochemical, and refining customer base.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The net result was an increase of ten inland tank barges and approximately 0.2 million barrels of capacity.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increases for the 2022 third quarter and first nine months were primarily due to increased tank barge utilization, higher term and spot pricing, and higher fuel rebills in the inland and coastal markets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities for the 2022 first nine months decreased in comparison to the 2021 first nine months primarily due to the receipt of a tax refund of $119.5 million, including accrued interest, for the Company’s 2019 federal tax return during the 2021 first quarter.
